newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Spokesman confirms Yeltsin to have heart operation.
newsitem.headline: Spokesman confirms Yeltsin to have heart operation.

text.p: The head of President Boris Yeltsin's press service confirmed on Thursday that the 65-year-old Kremlin leader had agreed to have a heart operation.
Igor Ignatyev said by telephone he could confirm Russian news agency reports that Yeltsin had said in an interview with RIA television that he had agreed to have the operation.
The interview would be shown at 6 or 7 p.m. (1400 or 1500 GMT), Ignatyev said.
